title: 36 Hours in Zermatt, Switzerland
abstract: Gliding among pale blue glaciers, breathing the hard, clean wind on nearly 200 miles of marked trails, is the essence of skiing in this town defined by altitude.

title: 36 Hours in Lisbon
abstract: The city is flaunting its playful side these days, from edgy design shops to chic late-night lounges that have turned this old port city into a youthful place to party.

title: 36 Hours in Ho Chi Minh City
abstract: Vietnam’s largest city has an energy and noise level that can be at once exhilarating and wearying.

title: 36 Hours in Siem Reap, Cambodia
abstract: The town that lodges and feeds Angkor’s million annual visitors has evolved into a chic haven of rest and relaxation.

title: 36 Hours in Maui
abstract: Visitors to Hawaii’s second-biggest island, known for its sparkling coastline, fertile green interior and high-end resorts, will find bargains everywhere.
